name: BRACE
description: Be Ready Alliance Coordinating for Emergencies (BRACE) is Northwest Florida’s leading disaster preparedness, response, and recovery organization. Serving Escambia and Santa Rosa Counties, BRACE strengthens community resilience by coordinating more than 500 partner organizations, training volunteers through Citizen Corps, CERT, and Fire Corps programs, and managing both county Long-Term Recovery Groups. As the fiscal agent and ESF-15 (Volunteers & Donations) lead for Escambia County and Santa Rosa County Emergency Management, BRACE mobilizes resources and volunteers before, during, and after disasters to meet the needs of impacted families. The organization also leads public education efforts such as the StormWise Disaster Preparedness Workshop, Disaster Services Expo, Faith Leader Emergency Summit, Disaster Services RoundTable, and Storms & Stars Soiree, which connect residents, businesses, and community leaders with the tools and training to prepare, mitigate, and recover from disasters. Through collaboration, compassion, and innovation, BRACE helps Northwest Florida build safer, stronger, and more resilient communities.

The mission of Hope is to engage our unchurched neighbors of every age and ethnicity to experience Jesus. The way we accomplish this mission is through community, service, generosity and worship. The EPC is both evangelical and Presbyterian. We are evangelical (not in the political sense but the biblically gracious sense) in our zeal for the Gospel, local/global missions and living obediently as followers of Jesus. At the same time, we are rooted in the Protestant Reformation and—secondary to the Holy Bible—we embrace the Westminster Confession of Faith as our doctrinal standard.

name: MissionLink
description:
Here's a 5-sentence overview you can drop into your Serve Source profile:

MissionLink is a Houston-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit that serves as a turnkey community outreach platform, connecting churches, businesses, and civic partners around real, tangible needs across the city. Founded by Anthony and Michelle Minor and built on more than ten years of Houston outreach experience, MissionLink handles the full execution of community initiatives — logistics, volunteer coordination, partner relationships, and reporting — so its partners can focus on serving rather than operations. The organization runs lean and carries no overhead, directing resources straight to the people and programs it exists to reach. MissionLink has served alongside the City of Houston on disaster relief, summer feeding, and neighborhood beautification, and partners with national and global relief organizations including Convoy of Hope, Mercy Chefs, World Vision, and Feed the Hunger. Guided by the belief that every link matters, MissionLink exists to meet Houstonians where they are and make a measurable, lasting impact in the communities it serves.

name: Newbridge Church
description:
Newbridge Church traces its roots back to 1979, when God called a group from California’s Jesus Movement to plant a church in Wheeling. The church was marked by a focus on the life-changing experience of salvation through faith in Jesus Christ—emphasizing authenticity, simplicity, and a vibrant community that pointed a generation toward Jesus.

Today, we carry on that same legacy. We do this through weekly worship, biblical preaching, and the intentional building of community through events and life groups.

Our mission is simple: to help people find and follow God.

name: Nightlight Christian Adoptions
description: Serve foster/adoptive families, adopted children, and placing parents by providing paths toward adopting and post adoption support. Post Adoption support is offered to any family, regardless if they adopted through Nightlight.

name: No More Thirst
description: To hand out water and tell people they are loved by us and most of all Jesus

name: NorthRock Church
description: At NorthRock Church, we are rooted in eternal truths, the teachings of the Bible. We are guided by Biblical foundational beliefs and shaping values.

name: Northpoint Community Church
description: Our church supports teaching missionaries around the world.  Locally, we provide brand new uniforms to 12 Title 1 schools and the Title 1 office in Bossier Parish; as well as providing weekend and holiday break meal bags to those same schools.

name: On Mission Network
description: Christian disaster response providing chainsaw, feeding, shower laundry, chaplain,  rebuild and other services through the local churches.

name: One Gen Away
description: One Generation Away is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization that has been feeding bellies and souls since 2013. Founded by Chris and Elaine Whitney, OneGenAway rescues high-quality, surplus food from grocery stores, restaurants, farms, and caterers and redistributes that food to individuals and families experiencing food insecurity.1. Mobile Food Pantries We operate regular mobile pantries throughout Middle Tennessee, delivering fresh produce, pantry staples, dairy, and protein directly into neighborhoods with limited access to nutritious food. These pantries serve individuals and families experiencing food insecurity, including children, working adults, seniors, and those without reliable transportation. 2. Partner Agency Distribution We supply food to local nonprofit partners—churches, community centers, and social service organizations—that serve their own communities. This extends our impact by supporting front-line organizations addressing ongoing hunger needs across the region. 3. Disaster Relief We look to assist groups that on the ground immediately with food resources that are requested as we have them available. We then reach out 3-4 months after the disaster to find partners that want to do food distributions as the city/region recovers. We then look to make a long term commitment (8 months to 2 years) to providing food for a mobile food distribution that will feed 300 families a full grocery cart full of food (about 85 pounds, that includes fresh produce).

name: One Mission Bible Church
description:
Mission: Love God, love people, and make disciples of Jesus.

Vision: Our vision is to be a community of transformed lives living out our God-given mission of making disciples.

About: We are a new church planted in Leander but rooted in a long-standing legacy of gospel saturation in the greater Austin area. From the beginning, our prayer has been to join God in the work He is already doing—seeing lives impacted and transformed by the good news of Jesus Christ.
Our church family loves God, loves people, and seeks to make disciples of Jesus. Life together centers on following Jesus in everyday ways—growing in our faith through studying Scripture, praying, and engaging in meaningful relationships. We believe the gospel is meant to be shared and multiplied. As God leads, we invest in people and trust Him with the future, sending and supporting others for the sake of His kingdom.
We believe everyone has a place and a purpose in God’s story. As a community, we encourage one another to live out our faith with intention, generosity, and compassion—serving one another, caring for our neighbors, and engaging the diverse city around us with humility and love.
Whether you are exploring faith, returning to church, or looking for a church family to call home, you are welcome here!

name: One Voice NOLA
description: One Voice Nola is Meeting the Needs of Our Communities in Their Most Difficult Moments. We serve thousands of hot, nourishing meals to those affected by disaster, offering not only comfort but also the life-changing hope found in the Gospel.

name: Operation Airdrop Inc.
description: Operation Airdrop, Inc. is a Texas-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization that mobilizes volunteer pilots and privately owned aircraft to deliver emergency supplies to disaster-stricken areas. Formed in 2017 during Hurricane Harvey, the organization specializes in "week one" relief, providing immediate aid to communities rendered inaccessible by ground transportation.

name: Operation Blessing
description: The mission of Operation Blessing (OB) is to bring help and hope to a hurting world, empowering people in need through compassionate, Christ-centered relief and development programs.

name: Operation Compassion
description:
Our Mission is to show compassion from across the street to across the sea.

Our world is in crisis. While life may seem hopeless for so many, Operation Compassion has been giving hope to those in need around the globe for over 25 years -  and you can help us give them hope. From disaster relief, to providing clean water sources, to life rehabilitation programs, and community food resources, Operation Compassion is making a difference.

description: Mission: Our mission is to empower communities to work together to eliminate social isolation and the hopelessness it causes. Imagine with us a world where no one navigates life alone. See website for details.

name: Pensacola Dream Center
description: The Pensacola Dream Center is a community of passionate and loving people, united in purpose to reach the needy, at-risk and underserved in our community with the love of Christ by meeting both physical and spiritual needs. We will rescue people out of poverty, addictions, homelessness and human trafficking by maximizing the combined efforts of diverse social services and community resources.

description: Pleroo brings emerging networking and communication technology to the mission field. We build relationships with teams already on mission, understand their needs, develop then deploy solutions that transform the way they do their mission work.

name: Praying Pelican Missions
description: At Praying Pelican Missions, we believe that healthy, short-term domestic and international mission trips are possible by building upon genuine partnerships, long-term relationships, and sustainable ministry. We look forward to you partnering with us for your group's mission trip.

name: Reset Mentoring
description:
Reset Mentoring reaches teens who have been involved with the the legal system, helping to reset their lives by bringing them the gospel and practically meeting needs through life skill training and connection.  We partner with local churches because we have found upon release a teen who had previously not attended church won't go more than 10 miles to get plugged into a church.   We believe that by making connection, sharing the gospel, mentoring, training and getting them plugged into a local church their chances of breaking generational patterns increase exponentially.

Round Mountain Baptist Church
description:
MISSION STATEMENT
     To be a dynamic spiritual body of believers empowered by the Holy Spirit to share Christ with as many people as possible in our church, community and throughout the world.
     To be a worshiping fellowship, experiencing an awareness of God, recognizing His person and responding in obedience to His leadership.
     To experience and increasingly meaningful fellowship with God and fellow believers.
     To help people experience a growing knowledge of God and man.
     To be a church which ministers unselfishly to persons in the community and the world in Jesus’ name.
     To be a church whose purpose is to be Christlike in our daily living by emphasizing total commitment of life, personality and possessions to the lordship of Christ.

Central location and support during 2025 Central Texas Flood in impacted Leander area.  Worked with local churches, ADRN, Travis County, and other non-profits.

name: SERVE 6.8
description: SERVE 6.8 is able to create a strong network of churches to meet the needs of the community by maximizing resources and volunteers from local and national business and church partners.

name: Safe Families for Children
description:
Safe Families for Children focuses on partnering through churches to prevent neglect and abuse for children through community and social support. Think of extended family, providing a safe place and friendship during a time of great need and building up resources so that their is growth and resiliency in the future. 

They host two fundraisers per year, a fall and spring. One for awareness (Nov 9th) and one for fundraising (Feb 21st ten.). 
Churches partner through volunteers and creating circles of support, there are levels of commitment and a space for everyone. Ministry lead, Family Coach, Host Family, Family Friend and Resource Friend. 
They host in person trainings every couple of months to bring on new volunteers, depending on the role you need to attend one to three trainings and then be background checked and interviewed. 
The church is benefited by an area of service and a tangible easy way to step into the community and invite people into the church family.

description: SBSK provides Austin’s only free, faith-based after school program, serving hundreds of students every week. SBSK has programs on five campuses across Austin and in areas where 96% of families are economically disadvantaged. With our after school program, 98% of students advance to the next grade level and equip themselves with skills for future success and well-being. See website for details.

name: Simple Sparrow
description:
Learn care. Grow compassion. Heal the world.
We teach people how to care for land, gardens, and animals so they are better able to care for themselves and others. 

A care farm utilizes farm nature for educational, therapeutic, and/or vocational outcomes.
See website for details.

description: Sirens Project ASSISTS communities, non-profits, and local authorities through the organization and deployment of skilled VOLUNTEERS, SUPPLIES, and SPECIAL EQUIPMENT in response to natural disasters.

name: Slavic Protestant Christian Church
description:
Slavic Protestant Christian Church is an independent Protestant Christian church registered as a nonprofit corporation in the State of Iowa, USA. Our primary ministry language is Russian, with English as an additional language. Our mission is to share the Gospel of Jesus Christ, teach the Bible, encourage people in faith, provide prayer and spiritual support, and welcome people from different backgrounds with love, dignity, and respect. We are developing an online ministry that includes worship services, Bible reading and teaching, prayer, evangelism, and Christian fellowship. As our ministry develops, we hope to expand our outreach and practical service to people in need.
We value Christian fellowship and cooperation with other churches and ministries while maintaining the full independence and autonomy of our church.

name: Stormwise
description: We teach community leaders how to face overwhelming crises with excellence. By putting a roadmap to success in their hands and building powerful tools specific to their needs, we decrease the extreme load on their shoulders while expediting their community’s recovery.

name: Texans on Mission
description: Texans on Mission delivers help, hope and healing through disaster relief and water ministry around the world and raises up the next generation to do.

name: Texas Baptist Children’s Home

name: Texas Reach Out
description:
Texas Reach Out provides participants with a room in a residential, furnished home in a safe atmosphere. 

Houses are drug and alcohol free and rely on structure and accountability. Participants have regular house meetings, random drug screenings, as well as house guidelines and chores.

One of the biggest things working against the formerly incarcerated are the environments that they return to after prison. Texas Reach Out combats this by providing environments in which participants can thrive. See website for details

name: The Apologist Project
description: The Apologist Project exists to be a force multiplier for missional organizations, leveraging conversational AI to help more people make a life-changing decision to follow Christ.

name: The Austin Stone Community Church
description:
The Austin Stone is a New Testament church with six congregations that exists for the supremacy of the name and purpose of Jesus. We believe Christ’s life, death, and resurrection are essential to God’s plan to heal and redeem our fallen world, and we're dedicated to being a part of what He’s doing in our city and throughout the nations.

For our Local Missions efforts, we aim to mobilize The Austin Stone congregations to love and serve people in Austin, especially the poor, marginalized, and vulnerable, reflecting God’s justice and mercy, and pointing all to our Savior.

name: The Chapel
description:
We are a non-denominational church and part of a church planting initiative called ARC, which is the Association of Related Churches. 

The Association of Related Churches (ARC) is an organization of pastors and churches that focus on building strong relationships between pastors and ministry leaders. The ARC is available to encourage, provide guidance, and help with ministry development for pastors across the U.S.

name: The Crossing Church
description: The Crossing church is a multi-site, non denominational church in St. Louis, Missouri. Join us this weekend in Chesterfield, Fenton, Grant's Trail or Mid Rivers.

name: The God of Hope Ministries

name: The Key2Free
description:
Serving Adult, Female Survivors of Sexual Exploitation and Sex Trafficking
Through providing of safe housing, therapeutic care and life skills programming, we strive to empower survivors of exploitation on their journey of healing.  See website to connect.

name: The Life Church
description: The Life Church is here to love and serve our community in this time of need. We’re committed to doing everything we can to support those affected by the recent flooding.

name: The Refuge
description: As the severity and scope of domestic minor sex trafficking in the United States gains wider attention, more children are identified and recovered from exploitative situations than ever before, but few have access to the broad range of therapeutic services needed to begin their healing journey. Our response is to provide a place that offers the very best care available to child survivors. See website to connect.

Transformation Church is a place where people can meet Jesus, engage in a life-giving community, and everyone is welcome.
 

 We believe in creating a space where people can have authentic encounters with Christ, discover their gifts and use them for God's glory.
 

 Join us for our Sunday services!

name: Trotter House - Austin Pregnancy Resource Center
description:
We partner with all groups supporting life and families. In January, we celebrate 20 years at our location on West Campus of UT.  We work with the pro-life student organizations and offer free services to those in need.  We also offer life skills programs and have professional Christian counselors on site offering their services to our clients.
October is our annual fundraiser.
Benefits of the relationship is first to forward the message of the Gospel and to link arms to help those in need.

name: TruCare
description:
TruCare is a licensed, non-profit medical clinic providing safe and confidential limited medical services. Our services and programs will provide you with accurate information on all options regarding an unplanned pregnancy, including abortion, adoption and parenting.

Our clinic serves Austin and its surrounding area providing safe limited medical services and support to women in our community facing unexpected pregnancy. We will give you accurate and honest information on all your options as it relates to your specific pregnancy. See website for details.

name: Trumpet Call Ministries
description: TCMI – The Meeting Place continues to stand with families and communities in Jamaica through worship, prayer, practical support, and ongoing community care.

name: WAM INC. | WITNESS AS MINISTRY
description: WAM is a faith-based 501(c)3 in Keller, Texas and also a registered charity in Lebanon. We were founded in 2011 in response to the Syrian refugee crisis in Lebanon. We have grown beyond that mission, seeking to alleviate human suffering throughout the Middle East and Africa. We respond to war, displacement, extreme poverty, natural disasters, and religious persecution. We prioritize woman-led families, displaced families, and families with children, elderly or disabled people. We seek to serve the least of these, functioning as a parachurch in distributing humanitarian aid where it is most needed and in places other organizations cannot reach.

name: Water Mission
description: Water Mission is a Christian engineering nonprofit charity dedicated to ending the global water crisis by providing disaster response, sanitation and hygiene solutions, and safe, clean water.

name: Waterfront Rescue Mission
description: Waterfront Rescue Mission provides immediate-need services (hot meals, clothing distribution, overnight shelter), as well as longer-term rehabilitation programs for addiction and homelessness, for adult men and women.

name: World Relief
description: At World Relief our mission is to empower the local church to serve the most vulnerable. See website for details.

name: World Renew - Disaster Response Services
description:
We come together to help communities rebuild after disasters like hurricanes, floods, and tornadoes. We believe our partnerships make us stronger and help us to better support the needs of those who need assistance the most.

Our partnerships with local long-term recovery organizations help strengthen their capacity, creating a strong network that can respond effectively to the local community’s needs.

We also partner with churches and their volunteer networks, such as the Christian Reformed Church in North America (CRCNA), the Reformed Church in America (RCA), the Alliance of Reformed Churches (ARC), and the ECO Presbyterian Church, so that we can provide the right support at the right time to communities affected by disaster.

name: World Vision
description: World Vision is a faith-based global charity powered by Jesus’ love. It’s the foundation of our programs and the reason we serve in the places where it’s hardest to be a child.

name: Worship on the Water
description:
Starting in 2011, Worship on the Water was birthed out of a desire to BE the Church, not just build another one. With a burden to reach the lost, hurting, traveling, or wondering... Worship on the Water began meeting people at the world-famous Flora-Bama. Known for it’s iconic music environments, it’s drinks, and a place where all are welcome, Flora-Bama opened it’s doors and has partnered with Worship on the Water in a way that we hope to duplicate all over the Gulf Coast.

Since first opening the doors to turn a tent stage into a place of worship every Sunday, tens of thousands of locals and tourists alike have visited this special place. Thousands have made decisions to commit their lives to Christ, and even followed that up with being baptized just steps away in the Gulf.

Our focus is simple: raise up uncommon people, to carry uncommon faith into uncommon places. We hope you’ll join us!

name: YAIPAK
description: Headquarters are located in Clarksville Tennessee. We have a branch in Texas and Missouri. We are able to mobilize our trucks to deliver much needed supplies as well as a mobile kitchen and Mobile laundry unit. We are a CAP partner of the Red Cross. We train with Fort Campbell in the event of catastrophic events. We provide Radio comms such as Ham Radio etc
